TOYO 董事长兼首席执行官小野塚恭彦（Takahiko Onozuka）表示：“我们对 2026 年上半年业绩感到非常满意，这反映出公司全球制造平台的持续实力，以及我们在各市场所看到的需求增长。在近期针对多晶硅及其衍生品作出的 232 条款裁定之后，我们确实预计下半年业绩将受到影响，但影响幅度尚不确定，目前我们正与美国商务部就有助于应对这一问题的框架进行沟通。待情况进一步明朗后，我们将提供更多信息。”
TOYO 首席战略官 Rhone Resch 表示：“TOYO 支持构建安全、具竞争力的美国太阳能供应链，并正为此投入资本。

w:r.w:delText: 这包括我们位于休斯顿的 2 GW 太阳能组件工厂，以及在德克萨斯州 Humble 新建先进 HJT 太阳能电池工厂的 3.57 亿美元投资。

w:r.w:t: 这包括我们位于大休斯顿地区德克萨斯州 Humble 的一体化太阳能生产基地，包括 2 GW 的太阳能组件工厂及新建的 1.5 GW HJT 电池工厂。
我们正与商务部就一项投资抵扣安排展开沟通，该安排将支持上述产能建设，同时保持对美国太阳能组件制造商的电池供应。TOYO 将继续致力于发展美国太阳能制造业、支持美国就业，并构建安全的非 FEOC（受关注外国实体）供应链。”
2026 年 6 月 25 日，公司完成面向若干机构投资者的注册直接发行，募集资金总额 5,000 万美元，净额约 4,710 万美元。
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，公司通过与 Roth Capital Partners, LLC 及 H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC 设立的 ATM 股权计划募集净额约 550 万美元。
2026 年 6 月年度成分调整生效后，TOYO 被纳入罗素 3000® 指数及罗素微型股（Microcap®）指数。
自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起，原田康成（Yasunari Harada）获任命为首席财务官，接替于 2026 年 6 月 30 日辞任的郑泰佑（Taewoo “Raymond” Chung）。
根据 2026 年 7 月 21 日公布的第三方税务合规分析，Toyo Solar Texas LLC 预计将符合 2025 纳税年度 45X 条款先进制造生产抵免资格。

w:r.w:delText: 公司位于德克萨斯州休斯顿工厂的第二条 1 GW 太阳能组件生产线即将建成，预计于 2026 年 9 月投产。投产后，TOYO 休斯顿组件制造总产能将达到约 2 GW。

w:r.w:t: 公司位于大休斯顿地区德克萨斯州 Humble 园区的第二条 1 GW 太阳能组件生产线即将建成，预计于 2026 年 9 月投产。投产后，该园区组件制造总产能将达到约 2 GW。

w:r.w:t: TOYO 此前公布的 1.5 GW 先进异质结（HJT）太阳能电池生产线（投资额 3.57 亿美元）与公司太阳能组件工厂同处德克萨斯州 Humble 的同一园区。项目按照正常进度推进，公司重申该产线将不晚于 2028 年第一季度进入试产。
TOYO 对特朗普政府就多晶硅作出的 232 条款裁定表示欢迎，并重申其在德克萨斯州 Humble 的 3.57 亿美元 HJT 工厂投资。

TOYO 是一家太阳能解决方案公司，致力于成为全球市场的全方位太阳能解决方案供应商，整合上游硅料及硅片生产、中游太阳能电池生产、下游光伏组件生产，并可能延伸至太阳能供应链的其他环节。TOYO 具备以有竞争力的规模和成本生产高质量太阳能电池的良好条件。

“We are very pleased with our first-half 2026 results, which reflect the continued strength of our global manufacturing platform and the growing demand we’re seeing across our markets,” said Takahiko Onozuka, Chairman and CEO of TOYO. “Following the recent Section 232 determination on polysilicon and its derivatives, we do expect an impact on our second-half results, though the magnitude is not yet certain, as we are currently in discussion with the Department of Commerce on a framework that would help address it. We will provide further updates as more clarity emerges.”
“TOYO supports building a secure, competitive American solar supply chain, and we’re putting capital behind it,” said Rhone Resch, Chief Strategy Officer of TOYO. “

w:r.w:delText: That includes our 2 GW solar module facility in Houston and a $357 million investment in a new advanced HJT solar cell facility in Humble, Texas.

w:r.w:t: That includes our integrated solar manufacturing campus in Humble, Texas, in the greater Houston area, comprising our 2 GW solar module facility and the new 1.5 GW advanced HJT solar cell facility on the same site.

We are working with the Department of Commerce on an investment offset that would support this buildout while keeping cell supply available to U.S. solar module makers. TOYO remains committed to growing U.S. solar manufacturing, supporting American jobs, and building a secure, non-FEOC supply chain.”

Registered Direct Offering: On June 25, 2026, the Company closed a registered direct offering with certain institutional investors for gross proceeds of $50.0 million and net proceeds of approximately $47.1 million.

At-the-Market Offering: As of June 30, 2026, the Company had raised approximately $5.5 million in net proceeds from at-the-market offerings under its at-the-market equity program with Roth Capital Partners, LLC and H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC.
Russell Index Inclusion: Effective following the June 2026 annual reconstitution, TOYO was added to the Russell 3000® Index and the Russell Microcap® Index.
CFO Transition: Effective July 1, 2026, Yasunari Harada was appointed Chief Financial Officer, succeeding Taewoo (Raymond) Chung who resigned effective June 30, 2026.

Section 45X Tax Credit Eligibility: Toyo Solar Texas LLC expects to qualify for Section 45X Advanced Manufacturing Production Credits for the tax year 2025, based on a third-party tax compliance analysis announced on July 21, 2026.

w:r.w:delText: Houston Module Capacity Expansion:

Construction of the Company’s second 1 GW solar module production line at its Houston, Texas facility is nearing completion, with production expected to begin in September 2026. Once operational, this will bring TOYO's total Houston solar module manufacturing capacity to approximately 2 GW.

w:r.w:t: Construction of the Company’s second 1 GW solar module production line at its Humble, Texas facility, in the greater Houston area, is nearing completion, with production expected to begin in September 2026. Once operational, this will bring TOYO's total solar module manufacturing capacity at that site to approximately 2 GW.

w:r.w:delText: TOYO's previously announced 1.5 GW advanced heterojunction (HJT) solar cell manufacturing line in Humble, Texas — a $357 million investment — is targeting pilot production in late 2027 or early 2028.

w:r.w:t: TOYO's previously announced 1.5 GW advanced heterojunction (HJT) solar cell manufacturing line — a $357 million investment, located on the same Humble, Texas site as the Company's solar module plant — is progressing on schedule. TOYO reaffirms that the line will enter pilot production no later than the first quarter of 2028.

Section 232 Polysilicon Determination: TOYO welcomed the Section 232 determination of the Trump Administration on polysilicon, reaffirming TOYO’s $357 million HJT facility investment in Humble, Texas.

Together, these investments mark real progress toward a larger, increasingly integrated U.S. manufacturing platform built to meet growing demand for high-performance solar products,” said Takahiko Onozuka, Chairman and CEO of TOYO.

“The recent Section 232 proclamation reinforces the importance of this strategy. We believe TOYO’s module operations, planned HJT capacity, use of American polysilicon, and broader non-FEOC supply chain align closely with the Trump Administration’s onshoring goals. While near-term implementation details remain uncertain, we view the policy direction as supportive of TOYO’s long-term position in the U.S. market,” said Rhone Resch, Chief Strategy Officer of TOYO.
